content: Due to its effectiveness and safety profile, metformin and glyburide are used in limited cases. However, these medications are known to cross the placenta, raising concerns about their potential effects on the fetus. For instance, metformin has been associated with an increase in neonatal weight and waist-to-height ratios in offspring. On the other hand, glyburide has been linked to the occurrence of neonatal hypoglycemia.
